note: Read 2026-10-18. Pin numbers are BoosterPack pin numbers 1 to 40 (SLAA542 Figure 4). 'pins_used_set' lists the pins the board puts a signal on, for the clash matrix; empty means not resolved. Price and stock are TI.com page values read 2026-10-18. No em dashes.

standard.40pin_outline_mil: 2000 wide x 1700 high, or 1350 if J5 need not be reached (Figure 4, p.5)

clash_matrix.basis: Each BoosterPack's pin use against each LaunchPad kit's pin map, as shipped. H = hard: pin is NC, SWD, XDS110 UART net, or a part you cannot remove with a shunt. J = fixable by moving or pulling a jumper or shunt. Loads on analog parts are ignored. Counts include optional pins. G3519 and G5187 rows added 2026-10-20; their sources are under host_sources. On the G5187 a pin counts as hard when the header that carries it (J2 or J4) is not fitted on our unit.

G3519.doc: SLAU947 (LP-MSPM0G3519 user guide, Oct 2024) Table 2-1 and Figure 4-2, read 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-20

jumper_pins.33: PA11 UART0 RX through selector J13
jumper_pins.34: PA10 UART0 TX through selector J12
jumper_pins.9: I2C pull-up PC2 (J15), harmless to every pack here
jumper_pins.10: I2C pull-up PC3 (J14), harmless to every pack here

G3519.note: No header pin 1 to 40 is unconnected. SLAU947 lists headers J1 to J4 as unpopulated; our unit has them fitted.

G5187.doc: SLAU967 (LP-MSPM0G5187 user guide, Nov 2025) Table 2-1 and Figure 2-3; unfitted headers from mspm0g5187/FAQ.md; read 2026-10-20

jumper_pins.5: PB21 also reaches the USB2 VBUS divider through J23 (a shunt is fitted on our unit); pull J23

G5187.hard_pins: 11 to 20 and 31 to 40: headers J2 and J4 are not fitted on our unit, so a pack seated on it reaches only J1 and J3 (pins 1 to 10 and 21 to 30). A wire from the pack's top socket to a spare J1 pin works around it.
G5187.note: Pack signals on J2 or J4 (pins 11 to 20, 31 to 40) need wires or soldered headers.
